basis: FEED-011 establishes the 30-point projective-line boundary and warns that a fixed infinity point collapses PGL to the 812 affine maps.
H015 tested only one finite-domain inversion with 0->0 and no separator; this hypothesis is therefore a distinct full PGL enumeration with an explicit separator contract.
The user explicitly authorized all Möbius transformations on 29 runes plus one separator.
hypothesis: One common PGL(2,29) substitution, including genuine movement of the separator point, produces a language score that generalizes from discovery pages to held-out pages.
falsifiable_predictions: The canonical matrix list contains exactly 24,360 elements: 812 affine representatives [[a,b],[0,1]] and 23,548 non-affine representatives [[a,b],[1,d]].
The synthetic gate recovers at least 18/20 hidden inverse transformations and accepts 0/99 public negatives under the fixed complete 30-symbol scorer.
After discovery selects one matrix, holdout is scored with that matrix only; any lead must survive both 999-control families and the same at-least-two-page Holm-adjusted p<=0.003 rule.

sources.role: Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.

applicable_objects: All 55 rune-bearing pages; discovery D=LP2/0..27, holdout H=LP2/28..55 excluding LP2/50.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; its alphanumeric grid is a hard literal and is not converted.

representation: P1(F29)={0..28,infinity}, with infinity represented internally as 29. Only literal '-' is a projective point; slash, whitespace, other punctuation, section markers, semicolon and grid literals remain hard/side-boundary metadata.

enumeration.formula: f(x)=(a*x+b)/(c*x+d); denominator zero maps to infinity; f(infinity)=a/c when c!=0 and infinity otherwise.
enumeration.non_affine_pole: For c=1, f(infinity)=a and f(-d)=infinity; separator/rune exchange is part of the model.

scoring.model: 30-symbol first-order add-one language model trained only from data/synthetic/training.txt; each raw hard segment is scored without cross-boundary transitions.
scoring.selection: Enumerate every matrix, take equal-weight mean of page scores over D, choose one matrix by score, then freeze it for H; ties use canonical (a,b,c,d) order.
scoring.holdout: H is never used to choose the matrix or the separator policy.
scoring.affine_reporting: If the selected representative has c=0, report it as an affine result; do not call it evidence for non-affine poles.

power_gate.acceptance: At least 18/20 hidden expected inverse matrices rank first and 0/99 negatives reach the fixed positive acceptance; failure is inconclusive and no LP2 interpretation is made.

families: Within each legal segment, random permutation of all 30 points, preserving composition and hard boundaries
One common random S30 bijection over the full corpus, preserving order and repeats
controls.warning: Random PGL maps are not a control: full PGL enumeration makes the max score invariant under a group re-labelling.
controls.multiple_testing: Each control repeats full discovery enumeration/selection; holdout uses the selected matrix only. Item alpha is 0.01/3=0.003 and page comparison uses Holm correction.

independent_validation_path: A separate loop verifies representative count, three-point images, determinant, 30-point bijection, inverse table and pole cases; it independently recomputes selected discovery/holdout scores and control maxima.
uncovered_parameters: physical grid conversion and non-language structural scores
